verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no sign-in path with credential MFA. The franchise-tax portal starts keyless: you enter a Business Entity File Number and pass an image CAPTCHA, with no account. Formation runs through PDF upload, fax or mail rather than an authenticated portal. Keyless entry avoids biometric, in-person and mailed-PIN walls, but it is not the credential-MFA sign-in the story describes, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
